description: This file implements permission caching and checking logic for etcd's authentication system, including functions for merging permissions, checking key intervals and points, and managing a cache of user permissions.

classes.name: authStore
classes.description: Struct managing permission cache and synchronization for user permissions.

methods.name: getMergedPerms
methods.description: Merges permissions from user roles into a unified permission set.

methods.name: checkKeyInterval
methods.description: Checks if a key range has the specified permission type in the cache.

methods.name: checkKeyPoint
methods.description: Checks if a key point has the specified permission type in the cache.

methods.name: isRangeOpPermitted
methods.description: Determines if a range operation is permitted for a user on a given key/range.

methods.name: refreshRangePermCache
methods.description: Rebuilds the permission cache from the current user and role data.
